name: HEAVEN'S PIECE -REN-
source:
One day, Ren, a girl who calls herself a real angel, appeared before me from nowhere. Our life has just started.....

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ028950.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某一天，名叫莲、自称是真正天使的少女毫无征兆地出现在了我的面前。属于我们两人的生活才刚刚开始……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ028950.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
